storeos.description: A desktop application for managing WooCommerce orders, products, inventory, and multiple stores from one place.
features: Work faster with local caching and manual sync
requirements: A WooCommerce store served over HTTPS
WooCommerce REST API keys with Read/Write access

WooCommerce REST API keys with Read/Write access
